title: 4 – COATINGS
officialText:
4.1 PROTECTIVE COATINGS.—Component materials which oxidize or corrode when exposed to normal use environments shall be provided with protective coatings.

4.1.1 Sheet steel—Components fabricated from sheet steel shall be given an electro-galvanized, hot dipped galvanized cadmium coating, or zinc coating.

4.1.2 Aluminum alloy—Components fabricated from aluminum alloys shall be anodized when exposed to a corrosive atmosphere.
